quests.title: Super Moon
quests.text: The Super Moon rises. Slimes crawl out of the ground nearby. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

quests.title: Blood Moon
quests.text: The Blood Moon rises. The dead walk in numbers tonight. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

reward.note: Boosted mobs drop Moon Essence; use it for experience.

quests.title: Super Blood Moon
quests.text: The Super Blood Moon rises. The night is thick with the dead. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

quests.title: Harvest Moon
quests.text: The Harvest Moon rises. Crops give a fuller yield. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

quests.title: Super Harvest Moon
quests.text: The Super Harvest Moon rises. Crops give an exceptional yield. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

quests.title: Blue Moon
quests.text: The Blue Moon rises. Luck is with you, and learning comes cheap. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.

quests.title: Super Blue Moon
quests.text: The Super Blue Moon rises. Luck runs high and learning comes cheaper still. Play it however you like, or leave it as a misc task.
